- The difference norms are effectively zero at all layers and positions, indicating no measurable signal.
- The logit-lens readouts are the same across layers/positions and consist of generic high-frequency tokens, suggesting no directed preference.
- Patchscope injections yield identical, neutral “echo/identity” behavior across layers, with no consistent change in continuation.

This looks like either identical checkpoints or differences below the measurement noise floor; no interpretable behavioral or objective shift is supported by the data.
